findings.note: The contract pins stale specification digest 2740928c..., while its own comment identifies the current digest as 466465e0... and deliberately leaves the field unchanged. Consequently, the independent verification contract is not bound to the specification currently under review.

The required regression check is false. The supplied evidence reports multiple real, unwaived suite failures, so the implementation lacks passing regression verification even if the failures are believed to be outside T-003.

The required placeholder scan is false because CHANGELOG.md, a declared T-003 output, produces five findings. The scanner requires remediation or explicit human acceptance in a quality-gate report, and the bundle provides no such acceptance.
